Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: Joi's pricing accordion - three plan tiers (Monthly ₹499, Annual ₹2,999 with a SAVE badge, Lifetime ₹4,999) where tapping a tier smoothly expands its card in height to reveal details while the other tiers collapse.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Light paywall: the "Joi 9" logo lockup, a centered feature list (Daily summary, Reminders sync, Alternative icons, Custom alerts, Widgets, iCloud backup: Soon), then the stacked plan cards above a wide Subscribe button and a restore/privacy line.

## Motion spec
Pattern: single-selection accordion with height springs.
- Select: the tapped card expands (height spring ~300/24, ~350ms) revealing its detail row (billing note, per-month math); its radio/check fills and the card gets a dark border emphasis.
- Collapse: the previously selected card collapses in the same beat (matching spring), its details fading out as height shrinks.
- List integrity: cards below the expanding one slide down with the same spring - no jumps or overlaps.
- Subscribe: the button label/price context cross-fades to match the selected tier (150ms).

## Calibration
- Exactly one card is expanded at a time; never two open, never all closed once a selection exists.
- The SAVE badge on Annual stays visible in both collapsed and expanded states.

## Reduced motion
Cards swap expanded state with a 200ms cross-fade; list reflows instantly.

## Don't miss
- Prices in rupees with the Annual tier carrying the SAVE badge.
- The feature list stays fixed; only the plan stack moves.
